Parameter mix: Temperature 57.8%, DO 15.2%, pH 14.6%, Turbidity 7.3%, Conductivity 4.0%, Nitrate 1.1%.
Top 10 organizations supply 51.7% of results (top: WIDNR_WQX, 18.5%).
